hero.eyebrow: The building block of AI understanding

h1.h1-text: Vector embeddings: what a vector embedding is,

hero.hero-sub: A vector embedding is a numerical representation of data—like a word, sentence, or image—that captures its meaning in a high-dimensional space. Instead of storing text as words, embeddings convert it into a list of numbers that AI models can compare for semantic similarity. This is the core mechanism behind semantic search, recommendation systems, and modern AI applications.
hero.live: Every vector maps to a real-world concept, no black boxes.
